title: Code for: Temporal dynamics and evolution of Antarctic dry extremes using Multi-temporal Rarity Curves

creators.name: Nworgu, Uzoma C.
creators.affiliation: Institut des Géosciences de l'Environnement (IGE), Université Grenoble Alpes; Institute for Marine and Antarctic Studies (IMAS), University of Tasmania

description: Python scripts that produce the figures for a study applying the Multi-temporal Rarity Curve (MRC) framework to MAR v3.12 daily precipitation over Antarctic drainage basins, 1979–2023, to classify and characterise dry extremes.
